params.caption: 🎮 GTA 6 cuts paid hookups to focus on Jason and Lucia Rockstar has removed the series' long-running hookup options, including picking up sex workers, while private dances at the strip club remain — solo or as a couple. Jason Schreier noted you can't kiss anyone except your partner.
